basic_details.short_information: BEML Limited, a Government of India undertaking under the Ministry of Defence, has invited online applications for 6 contract Consultant posts in four specialties: Physician (1), Dermatologist (2), General Surgeon (2) and Radiologist (1). Each post needs an MBBS degree with the prescribed post-graduate qualification and 3 years' experience. The maximum age is 62 years, and compensation is fixed per visit. Applications are open on www.bemlindia.in until 18.00 Hrs on 7 December 2026 (Advt. No. KP/S/19/2026).

how_to_apply: Apply ONLINE only; the notice says this is mandatory. Go through the prescribed guidelines first and make sure the data entered in the portal/form is correct.
Open the online application form on the career page at www.bemlindia.in. The online registration site is available till 18.00 Hrs on 7 December 2026.
Register with a valid e-mail address and mobile number. BEML will use them for further correspondence and will not entertain a change of either during the recruitment process.
Note the registration number generated, for all future correspondence.
Upload the documents listed below along with the online application. Applications without them are incomplete and are summarily rejected.
Age proof: Xth / SSLC marks card and certificate
MBBS degree certificate (as applicable) along with marks card
Post Graduation certificate along with marks cards
Medical Registration Certificate (issued by State Medical Council or the Medical Council of India)
Previous experience (indicating start and end date at each organisation served), along with clear work experience certificate

content_sections.heading: BEML Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the pay amount per visit, the application fee or the selection process.

rows.details: BEML Limited (a Govt of India Undertaking)
Purely contractual, 1 year; may be extended, not exceeding 3 years of total engagement
Compensation fixed on a per-visit basis, paid at the end of the month

content_sections.heading: About BEML
content_sections.text: BEML Limited (CIN L35202KA1964GOI001530) is a Government of India undertaking headquartered at BEML Soudha, 23/1, 4th Main, Sampangirama Nagar, Bangalore-560 027. The notice describes it as a multi-technology company serving Defence and Aerospace, Rail and Metro, Power, Mining and Construction. It operates two hospitals, one each at its KGF and Bangalore facilities, and first aid centres at all its manufacturing complexes. These Consultants are sought to support those hospitals and first aid centres.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 6 vacancies across four posts (1 + 2 + 2 + 1). It gives no category-wise break-up. Management reserves the right to increase or decrease the vacancies based on requirements and availability of qualified candidates.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals may apply. The maximum age limit for Consultants is 62 years. Age, qualification and experience must be counted as on 07.12.2026. A candidate must hold the prescribed essential qualification, a valid registration with the concerned statutory authority and the minimum prescribed post-qualification experience (PQE). Otherwise the candidature is summarily rejected. Qualifications other than those prescribed, and qualifications acquired from a foreign university, are not accepted. The notice prints no desirable qualification. The age limit is the same for all four posts: maximum 62 years, as on 07.12.2026. The notice prints no minimum age and no age relaxation.

rows.essential_qualification_mandatory: MBBS graduate with MD/DNB degree in General Medicine from MCI recognised Institution/College
MBBS graduate with MD/DNB/Diploma degree in Dermatology from MCI recognised Institution/College
MBBS graduate with MS/DNB in General Surgery from MCI recognised Institution/College
rows.experience_mandatory: Minimum post-qualification experience of 3 years from any Govt/Pvt hospitals as full time/part time General Surgeon

rows.essential_qualification_mandatory: MBBS graduate with MD/DMRD in Radiology from MCI recognised Institution/College
rows.experience_mandatory: Minimum post-qualification experience of 3 years from any Govt/Pvt hospitals as full time/part time Radiologist / Sonologist

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The compensation is fixed on a per-visit basis. It is paid at the end of the month according to the total number of visits in that month. The notice prints no per-visit amount. For the General Surgeon post, major surgeries are carried out on a case-to-case remuneration basis. The engagement is purely contractual for 1 year. It may be extended based on performance and requirement as decided by the company, but total engagement cannot exceed 3 years. The contract can be terminated at any time by either side by giving one month's notice. The Consultant must arrange their own transportation and stay.

content_sections.heading: BEML Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice calls these duties "indicative". In charge of the medicine department and all activities related to it. Provide expert advice and guidance on specific medical conditions, diagnose, treat and manage complex disease, and mentor junior doctors. Carry out clinical/administrative responsibilities by CMO. Full time consultation. Weekly once visit to BEML medical centre Bengaluru complex. Visit the medical center twice a week for 4 hrs each visit to provide expert advice and guidance on specific dermatological conditions. Diagnose, treat and manage complex dermatological diseases. Weekly one visit to BEML medical centre Bengaluru complex and one visit to BEML medical centre KGF complex. Provide expert advice and guidance on specific surgical conditions. Diagnose, treat and manage complex surgical diseases. Carry out minor/major surgical procedures, with case-to-case remuneration for major surgeries. Visit the medical centre 8 hrs/day and 2 visits/week. Weekly one visit to BEML medical centre Bengaluru complex and one visit to BEML medical centre KGF complex. Review and interpret medical images from modalities like x-ray, CT scan and ultrasound. Provide a comprehensive report on imaging findings, including diagnosis, impressions and recommendations. Visit the medical centre 4 hrs/day and 2 visits/week.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BEML Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BEML has advertised 6 Consultant vacancies: 1 Physician, 2 Dermatologists, 2 General Surgeons and 1 Radiologist.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BEML Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The online registration site is available till 18.00 Hrs on 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for BEML Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Every post needs an MBBS degree plus the prescribed post-graduate qualification from an MCI recognised institution/college. That is MD/DNB in General Medicine (Physician), MD/DNB/Diploma in Dermatology (Dermatologist), MS/DNB in General Surgery (General Surgeon) or MD/DMRD in Radiology (Radiologist).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BEML Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Consultants is 62 years, counted as on 07.12.2026.

faq.question: Q5. How much experience is required?
faq.answer: A minimum of 3 years is mandatory for all four posts. For General Surgeon and Radiologist it must be post-qualification experience from any Govt/Pvt hospitals as full time/part time General Surgeon or Radiologist / Sonologist respectively.

faq.question: Q6. How is the Consultant paid?
faq.answer: Compensation is fixed on a per-visit basis and paid at the end of the month according to the total number of visits in that month. Major surgeries by the General Surgeon are on a case-to-case remuneration basis.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for BEML Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online only, through the application form on the career page at www.bemlindia.in. Upload the documents listed in the notice, including the Medical Registration Certificate and a detailed resume.

faq.question: Q8. Is the BEML Consultant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual for 1 year. It may be extended based on performance and requirement, but total engagement cannot exceed 3 years.

faq.question: Q9. Can foreign nationals or those with foreign qualifications apply?
faq.answer: Only Indian Nationals may apply. Qualifications acquired from a foreign university are not accepted.

faq.question: Q10. Will BEML pay travel allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.
